The '''L1-L Defender''' was a type of small [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] available during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. It was used by the [[Gree (species)/Legends|Gree]] on numerous planets, including [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]].

==Behind the scenes==
The L1-L Defender appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a pet. It is one of the possible rewards for defeating bosses during the Relics of the Gree event.
